<h2>New to Matcha Flavoured?</h2>
<p>Matcha Flavoured is a datapack and resource pack for ''Minecraft'' made by Klei Wright. It is designed so that casual, non-technical players get as much out of the game as players who build farms. Hunger and natural regeneration are gone: [[food]] heals the player and grants potion-like [[intrinsic]]s. A [[death]] costs a [[Crystal Heart|heart]] instead of the player's items. Villagers stop buying goods, so mob grinders and trading halls no longer pay. New [[alloy]]s, hybrid [[tools]] and a crafted [[enchanting]] system reshape progression.</p>
<p>Start with the [[Guide for new players|new player guide]], or see everything that is [[Changes from vanilla|different from vanilla]].</p>
